events.title: Dutch East India Company is founded
events.description: The States General granted the VOC a monopoly on Dutch trade in Asia. Financed by publicly traded shares, it could wage war, make treaties and found colonies, and dominated the spice trade.
events.html: The States General granted the VOC a monopoly on Dutch trade in Asia. Financed by publicly traded shares, it could wage war, make treaties and found colonies, and dominated the spice trade.

events.title: Napoleon returns to Paris
events.description: The day after Louis XVIII fled, Napoleon entered the Tuileries to cheering crowds. His restored rule, the Hundred Days, ended with defeat at Waterloo in June.
events.html: The day after Louis XVIII fled, Napoleon entered the Tuileries to cheering crowds. His restored rule, the Hundred Days, ended with defeat at Waterloo in June.

events.title: Harriet Beecher Stowe publishes 'Uncle Tom's Cabin'
events.description: Stowe's novel of slavery sold some 300,000 copies in America in its first year and stirred anti-slavery feeling in the North. Lincoln is said to have greeted her as the author who started the war.
events.html: Stowe's novel of slavery sold some 300,000 copies in America in its first year and stirred anti-slavery feeling in the North. Lincoln is said to have greeted her as the author who started the war.

events.title: Opponents of slavery meet at Ripon to form a new party
events.description: Meeting in a schoolhouse in Ripon, Wisconsin, opponents of the Kansas-Nebraska Act called for a new party. The Republican Party was organised that summer and won the presidency in 1860.
events.html: Meeting in a schoolhouse in Ripon, Wisconsin, opponents of the Kansas-Nebraska Act called for a new party. The Republican Party was organised that summer and won the presidency in 1860.

events.title: Kaiser Wilhelm II dismisses Bismarck
events.description: After disputes with the young Emperor, Otto von Bismarck's resignation as Chancellor was accepted. Without him, Germany's alliances shifted, as Britain's Punch caricatured in 'Dropping the Pilot'.
events.html: After disputes with the young Emperor, Otto von Bismarck's resignation as Chancellor was accepted. Without him, Germany's alliances shifted, as Britain's Punch caricatured in 'Dropping the Pilot'.

events.title: Einstein submits his general theory of relativity
events.description: 'The Foundation of the General Theory of Relativity' reached the journal Annalen der Physik. It described gravity as the curvature of spacetime and predicted the bending of light, confirmed in 1919.
events.html: 'The Foundation of the General Theory of Relativity' reached the journal Annalen der Physik. It described gravity as the curvature of spacetime and predicted the bending of light, confirmed in 1919.

events.title: Himmler announces the Dachau concentration camp
events.description: Munich's police chief Heinrich Himmler announced a camp for political prisoners near Dachau, opened two days later. It became the model for the Nazi camp system; over 40,000 died there.
